full_details: Saturday you had said Abel reads. This morning you read, every voice, and you read Costard badly so Kemp would mend him. Abel had seventeen parts copied in six days. Pope tried Armado's first letter, lost the third word, and the table could not help him. Kemp unrolled his part against Dick's on the floor. Neither of you called a winner. Augustine asked for the songs by Friday. You promised a pointing, not a new copy. Nick asked whether the Princess weeps after the news of her father. She governs. He marked his roll. The room repeated John's sentence from last night: the Princess wants a gown. John was not at the table. You ate little at home, played in the Shrew, and did not name the roll. Set at Maw was the Rose. You did not go.
one_sentence: You read the whole book at Dick's, gave out the seventeen rolls, and played in the Shrew at two.
title: Read the book at Dick's and played in the Shrew
